title: Molecular-level observation of the self-assembly of a virus-like particle.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Resolved the data DOI to its Oxford University Research Archive (ORA) record and read its DataCite metadata: size 440 GB, licence 'under embargo, all rights reserved', description 'TBD', storage 'ORA DeepData service, please contact the ORA team to discuss access'. The page offers only an email request form, with a release time of up to 48 hours. No file listing is public. The Europe PMC supplementary-file request timed out (one attempt).
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: That the archive holds raw mass photometry (MP, a method that weighs single molecules by how much light they scatter) videos and code to reproduce the figures; that the measurements are mass-versus-time traces of mi3 virus-like particle (VLP) subunits assembling on a supported lipid bilayer (SLB, an artificial membrane), recorded at 250–270 Hz.

a1_downloadable.note: Checked the ORA record: it is under embargo with all rights reserved and stored in DeepData. Access is only by an emailed request or by contacting the ORA team, so there is no direct download.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: From the paper only: the data are raw videos and mass traces. Oligomer states and transition times would have to be built by our own step-detection on the traces, so the label is not a column.

a3_inputs_present.note: Not checked; the files cannot be opened without a request.

a4_units_stated.note: Not checked; the archive description reads 'TBD' and lists no files.

a5_enough_rows.note: The number of assembly trajectories is unknown. The files were not seen.

a6_fits_laptop.note: Raw video totalling 440 GB, far above the ~5 GB laptop limit. Any processed trace subset is undocumented.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: Cannot compare, because there is no file listing.

a8_label_provenance.note: Any oligomer-state label would come from the authors' own trace analysis applied to the same signal, so it would be computed from the features.

honest_claim_h3: Not reached; rejected at Part A.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use single-molecule mass-over-time traces to predict which assembly intermediate a growing virus-like particle is in, and when it will next change.
plain_idea.train_on: Mass-versus-time traces from individual virus-like particles assembling on a membrane, recorded at about 250 frames per second. Number of traces unknown.
plain_idea.predict: The particle's assembly state (number of subunits) or the time to its next transition. The answer would come from the authors' own step-fitting of the same traces, not from an independent measurement.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Automated state calling could speed up analysis for mass photometry labs. But the data are embargoed, 440 GB of raw video, and the labels are derived from the traces themselves.

ml_idea: Classify oligomer states, or predict transition kinetics, from raw mass photometry traces of mi3 virus-like particle assembly. Not viable: the data are embargoed, 440 GB, and have no independent labels.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated, because the project failed Part A. The 440 GB size comes from DataCite metadata.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Open the ORA record: embargoed, 440 GB, access only by emailed request (already done; this kills it).

verdict_reason: A1 fails: the ORA (Oxford University Research Archive) dataset is under embargo with all rights reserved, 440 GB, and available only by emailed request to the DeepData service. It also fails A6 on size and A2/A8 because the only labels would be step-fits of the same raw traces.
